title.narrative: Demonstration of agro-industry innovation through science and technology in Fujian Province

description.narrative: Science and technology are an inevitable choice for China to further modernize the agriculture and to ensure a sustainable economic development. To support a sustainable industrial development the project will contribute to the creation of employment opportunities, reduction of poverty and of environmental pollution. This will be achieved through increasing the productivity, applying appropriate technology and improved management efficiency at farm and enterprise level by utilising the leading agricultural enterprises as best practice models. The gained knowledge and the improved technical and managerial capacities and capabilities of the lead agriculture enterprises will be disseminated and made accessible to all actors of the target value chains through so called demonstration bases. The institutionalization of these demonstration bases will guarantee a long lasting knowledge transfer and will be applicable to all the different agro sectors. Specifically for this project there will be a focus on two agro-products already successfully cultivated and processed: Spirulina and the Ling-Zhi mushroom as well as the successful implementation of scale cultivation of greenhouse vegetables on saline land.
